filters.name: safe
filters.title: Safe Giant
filters.summary: Mega-cap, relatively stable names with value characteristics, analyst upside, and a modest dividend — ranked by analyst upside.
filters.ranking: Analyst upside ((target_price − current_price) / current_price), highest first

criteria.meaning: Total market value of the company (shares outstanding × price)
criteria.why: Stick to giant / mega-cap firms that tend to be more liquid and durable

criteria.meaning: Volatility vs the broad market (1.0 ≈ moves with the market)
criteria.why: Cap high-volatility names; low beta is allowed for safety and diversity

criteria.meaning: Share of float sold short (0.10 = 10%)
criteria.why: Avoid crowded short interest (“no enemies”) that can spike volatility

criteria.meaning: Price-to-earnings (price per share / earnings per share)
criteria.why: Require profitability (P/E > 0) while excluding richly priced names

criteria.meaning: P/E divided by expected earnings growth (growth at a reasonable price)
criteria.why: Prefer growth that is not overpaying; PEG data is required

criteria.meaning: Implied upside from current price to consensus analyst target
criteria.why: Even “safe” names should still have meaningful expected appreciation

criteria.meaning: Analyst consensus score (1=Strong Buy … 5=Sell)
criteria.why: Bias toward Buy / Strong Buy; recommendation data is required

criteria.meaning: Annual dividend yield in percentage points (1.0 = 1%)
criteria.why: Prefer income support for longer holds while waiting on upside

disabled.meaning: Classic “golden cross” uptrend (50-day MA above 200-day MA)
disabled.why: Turned off as noisy — too many false signals for this strategy

filters.name: risky
filters.title: Risky Momentum
filters.summary: Liquid mid/large caps with high beta and short interest — short-squeeze / momentum candidates ranked by analyst upside.
filters.ranking: Analyst upside ((target_price − current_price) / current_price), highest first

criteria.meaning: Total market value of the company (shares outstanding × price)
criteria.why: Stay above micro-caps for basic size and liquidity safety

criteria.meaning: Average daily trading volume in shares
criteria.why: Need enough liquidity to enter and exit without huge slippage

criteria.meaning: Latest Yahoo Finance price
criteria.why: Exclude penny stocks that are hard to trade cleanly

criteria.meaning: Volatility vs the broad market (1.0 ≈ moves with the market)
criteria.why: Want names that move more than the market (action / momentum)

criteria.meaning: Share of float sold short (0.15 = 15%)
criteria.why: High short interest is the squeeze-potential signal

criteria.meaning: Implied upside from current price to consensus analyst target
criteria.why: Require a stronger value / upside case to justify the risk

rules.title: Dry-run safety net
rules.why: Paper-trade by default; flip TRADE_DRY_RUN only when ready for real fills

rules.title: Buys and sells only in regular hours
rules.why: Watchlist/buys and sell-check jobs skip when the US equity session is closed

rules.title: No buy-and-sell the same day
rules.set_to: No market sell or broker STOP_LIMIT until the next ET calendar day
rules.why: FINRA day trade = same trading day (not 24h). Buy Mon 1pm / sell Tue 8am is fine; stops are deferred so a same-day fill cannot create a round trip

rules.title: Cash floor
rules.why: No buy may leave cash (minus pending buys) below this floor. Sells still run.

rules.title: Account size floor
rules.why: No buy while account value is under this threshold. Sells still run.

rules.title: Buy only from the active filter / watchlist
rules.why: New buys must be on the current watchlist — no random tickers

rules.title: Fixed buy size
rules.why: Keeps position sizing consistent and cash-floor math simple

rules.title: Re-buy debounce after a sell
rules.set_to: 5 weekdays after sell OR ≤ last sell − 5%
rules.why: Avoid immediately rebuying the same name after a stop; unlock on cooldown or a meaningful discount

rules.title: Trailing stop arms after a gain
rules.why: Protect winners once they have moved enough; ignore noise before that

rules.title: Trail buffer below peak
rules.why: Stop sits at peak minus buffer and rises with new highs; re-syncs when buffers change; tighter once the thesis (watchlist) breaks

rules.title: Hard stop vs cost
rules.why: Catastrophe floor when a trail never armed, or thesis is gone

rules.title: Resting broker STOP_LIMIT
rules.set_to: Arm after next ET day · limit 0.50% below stop · GOOD_TILL_CANCEL
rules.why: Protective sell sits at Schwab once past the purchase day; never armed same day so a stop fill cannot create a PDT round trip

rules.title: Sell check cadence
rules.why: Re-evaluate trails / hard stops while the market is open

rules.title: Legacy holdings are sell-skipped
rules.set_to: Only algorithm / enrolled books get auto sells
rules.why: Pre-marked legacy carve-outs stay human-managed until enrolled

rules.title: Buys can be paused
rules.why: A runtime pause blocks new buys without changing the rest of the system
